clips.title: The story
paras: Deep beneath Moonbrook, Defias industry is poisoning the land. Alba Fairmoon suspects their metallurgical forge is the source of the blight and sends you to destroy it with explosives.

Beneath Moonbrook, the Deadmines shelter a fortified complex that powers the Defias Brotherhood. Its heavy forge smelts metal and builds machinery. Alba Fairmoon believes this forge is the likely origin of the contamination blighting the area. Destroying it is her aim.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The source of the poison is likely a large metallurgical forge of some kind. Find a way into the Deadmines and locate the forge, then place the explosives.
I will wait for you in the hills behind Moonbrook. Once you return, we can detonate the explosives. Hopefully, with the forge gone, the land can begin to heal.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Everything rests on you now, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So you found the forge, and planted the bomb... Only one thing remains to be done.
